articles.title: Daredevil Star Charlie Cox Asked for a James Bond Audition but Was Told He Was 'Too Old'
articles.summary: Daredevil star Charlie Cox says he was denied a James Bond audition after being told he was already "too old" to play 007.
articles.body:
Daredevil star Charlie Cox says he was denied a James Bond audition after being told he was already "too old" to play 007, prior to the casting of Twilight and Batman star Robert Pattinson .

Despite spending the past decade throwing himself into brutal hallway brawls, Cox said he couldn't even audition to be the new James Bond because of his age. Speaking today on Virgin Radio , the 43-year-old Marvel star said he'd asked his agent about becoming the new 00 agent, only to be quickly shut down.

"I asked to audition for that, do you know what they told me? Too old," Cox laughed, admitting that he didn't even make it into an audition room. "Rob's the same age as me!" he continued, before being told that, actually, the Batman actor is three years younger.

"What an amazing career that guy's carved out," Cox said, praising Pattinson for getting the part. "Some of the stuff he's done, the directors he's worked with... just amazing."

The Next James Bonds Who Never Played 007

While Cox wouldn't have been the oldest actor cast as James Bond, he would have certainly been on the older end. Sean Connery was 32 years old when he gained 007 status, George Lazenby was 30 years old, Roger Moore was 45 years old, Timothy Dalton was 41 years old, Pierce Brosnan was 42 years old, and Daniel Craig was 38 years old.

Still, for fans who have watched Cox effortlessly pull off both sharp-suited charm as Matt Murdock and relentless physical stunts as his superhero alter ego, ruling the actor out immediately is a shame — particularly now his crime-fighting days may be nearing an end with Disney's culling of Daredevil: Born Again following its forthcoming third season.

Pattinson's casting as Bond ended years of speculation over who would take on the role, and months of unusually detailed reporting on the actors who came close behind Pattinson in the running. Callum Turner (One Night Only) and Jacob Elordi (Euphoria) were two faces talked about earlier on, with Slow Horses star Jack Lowden then entering the conversation shortly after. Finally, just last month, Amazon reportedly narrowed its search to a small collection of actors , including Lowden, Turner, and Josh O'Connor (Challengers). Earlier in the process, everyone from Nicholas Hoult (Mad Max: Fury Road) to Dunkirk actor Harry Styles also tested. So, regardless of being allowed to audition or not, Cox faced some tough competition.

articles.title: Lion Dance Grandmaster - Lion Dance Grandmaster Memory Flower Locations - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Lion Dance Grandmaster is an optional collectible quest in Phantom Blade Zero's Pangzhen region. It can be easily started as the trigger point is along
articles.body:
Lion Dance Grandmaster is an optional collectible quest in Phantom Blade Zero's Pangzhen region. It can be easily started as the trigger point is along the main quest path, but hard to complete as the flowers you need to find are hidden away in places.

To begin the quest you need to pick up the first Lion Dance Grandmaster flower, which is located inside the building next to the Marketplace bell. This is after you defeat Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain .

Lion Dance Grandmaster Memory Flower Locations

There are another five flowers to find in the first half of Pangzhen's explorable area, mostly scattered within the residential area and estate itself.

Progress onwards until you reach the Huang Manor Crossroads bell. Just west, near the paper lanterns, you can find the next Memory Flower sat on a table.

Traverse all the way through Pangzhen until you reach the Narrow Alley Residence 2nd Floor bell. Just after it, you can grapple down to the lower part of Pangzhen. Next to the chest on the left is a house with one of Quick Hand Zhang's treasures in and the memory flower.

articles.title: Deborah Ann Woll Will Reprise Her Role as Faye in the God of War Show
articles.summary: Deborah Ann Woll will reprise her role as Faye in Prime Video's live-action God of War show.
articles.body:
Deborah Ann Woll will reprise her role as Faye in Prime Video's live-action God of War show .

It's the casting update everyone has been waiting for, even if some were worried it may never happen. Woll, who played the god-like character in God of War Ragnarok and will lead her own installment with God of War Laufey in 2027, will officially play the live-action version of Faye for the show.

"The mysterious late wife of Kratos and mother of Atreus, Faye's abrupt passing sets in motion the events of God of War," an official description shared by Amazon said. "Along their journey, Kratos and Atreus discover secrets about Faye that make them wonder how well they truly knew her at all."

Despite only physically appearing in one game thus far, Faye is a character who already has deep ties to Kratos and the rest of the series. In the franchise's 2018 installment, Faye serves as Kratos and Atreus' faceless guide as the father and son work to spread her ashes in Jötunheim.

Although their mission to let go of a powerful warrior, mother, and wife came to an end in the 2018 game, she continued to play an important role as Kratos faced the wrath of Norse gods like Thor and Odin in God of War Ragnarok in 2022. It was here that Woll first played the character, though only for a small portion of an otherwise meaty adventure.

Prime Video's God of War show picking Woll to return in live-action makes sense for more reasons than one. Besides also being set to spearhead God of War Laufey when it releases in May 2027, Woll is a proven talent with a live-action resume that plenty of movie and TV fans are already more than familiar with. In addition to notable roles in projects like True Blood, Escape Room, and The Cycle, she's also prominently played the role of Karen Page in Marvel projects like Daredevil and its Born Again follow-up show, as well as The Punisher.

"God of War follows father and son Kratos and Atreus as they embark on a journey to spread the ashes of their wife and mother, Faye," a series logline says. "Through their adventures, Kratos tries to teach his son to be a better god, while Atreus tries to teach his father how to be a better human."

The God of War series has no firm release date yet, and for good reason. After first casting Ryan Hurst as Kratos earlier this year, an unfortunate on-set injury led the project to recast the lead role . Guardians of the Galaxy and Knives Out alum Dave Bautista will now play the Leviathan Axe-wielding protagonist , with Callum Vinson still set as Atreus .

The show's cast also includes Mandy Patinkin as Odin , Ed Skrein as Baldur , Teresa Palmer as Sif , and more . Alastair Duncan will also reprise his role as Mimir . Since we already know Thor and Odin will show up, we can guess Prime Video's God of War story will be somewhat different from the games it draws from.

articles.title: A Piece of Cake Walkthrough - Disney Dreamlight Valley Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After creating a gumball avalanche and unblocking the path to Shortcake Summit in A Slippery Situation, Megara has told you that you need to climb the mountain
articles.body:
After creating a gumball avalanche and unblocking the path to Shortcake Summit in A Slippery Situation , Megara has told you that you need to climb the mountain to meet someone called "the Oracle." The Disney Dreamlight Valley Keepsake Sea Quest A Piece of Cake continues your journey with Megara as you travel through Candy Cove and find more Keepsakes to reclaim!

Talk to Megara, who will be standing at the top of Shortcake Summit . From the Shortcake Summit Wishing Well, turn left and follow the path across the bridge until you reach Meg standing in front of a locked gate.

Megara says that you will need to prove yourself. Milo Thatch appears, and translates the riddle on top of the the gate's archway. It reads:

This riddle can be found in the bottom left corner of the main Shortcake Summit area, south of the Wishing Well. There is a pickaxe symbol on a blue block.

Interact with the block. It says to bring it a "soft and chewy treat" that can be mined around Candy Cove. Bring the block Tap to Reveal to correctly solve this riddle. It can be mined from Rock Spots in any area of Candy Cove!

When you have given the block the correct item, you will receive a blue clothing pouch containing the Confectioner's Outfit.

The Riddle of the Dirt is located closest to the gate at the top of Shortcake Summit. Just to the right of the gate is a shovel symbol on a pink block.

Because the riddle requires "discovering what lies in the Earth," you need to dig anywhere in Candy Cove. Dig up Tap to Reveal and place it in the slot that appears when interacting with the pink block.

Pick up the blue pouch that appears and open it to claim the Confectioner's Dress.

Head back to the main Shortcake Summit area. About halfway up the right wall of the area, next to a narrow gorge, is a white block with a fish hook symbol.

Interact with the block ,which tells you to catch " something with a hardened shell and many legs ." The creature this refers to is the Tap to Reveal which can be caught in white ripples or open water anywhere in Candy Cove. Remember that, in your merfolk form, you can swim through ripples or harvest materials by Seacombing !

Interact with the block and place the many-legged creature in the slot. Pick up the blue pouch you receive and open it to get the Confectioner's Hat.

Once you have solved all three riddles, use the Wardrobe Menu to put on the Confectioner's Hat and EITHER the Confectioner's Dress or the Confectioner's Outfit.

Wearing these clothes, return to Meg at the gate and talk to her. She tells you that you can now pass through the gate!

Use your Royal Shovel to dig up the three pieces of Frosting in front of the gate. They drop Frosting Pudding, a food item you can eat to restore Stamina!

Climb the First Layer of Shortcake Summit

As you follow the path up Shortcake Summit's first layer, you will encounter ten candles which you must light. Light them by approaching them and selecting Interact.

To light all ten candles, follow this path:

Walk until you reach a giant blueberry blocking your path. In front of it are two candles with frosting piles in front of them. Dig up the frosting using your Royal Shovel, then light both candles.

Once both candles are lit, you can approach the blueberry and select "Interact" to push it out of the way.

Just past the blueberry are two more candles, one on the left and one on the right side of the path. Neither has any frosting in front of it, so go ahead and light them.

Keep walking until you reach a blueberry in front of an alcove. Select "Interact" to push the blueberry into the alcove.

Light the candle just past the blueberry.

There's a gap in the path! Pick up the Waffle Biscuit behind the candle and interact with the sparkling spot in front of the gap to use it as a bridge.

Walk through the tunnel. On the other side of the tunnel is another candle - light it.

There's another blueberry in front of you. Interact with it twice to push it off the edge of the mountain.

Just past the blueberry is a candle blocked by a Waffle Biscuit. Interact with the biscuit to push it out of the way. Then, light the candle.

At the base of the sloping path leading to the next layer are two more candles - light them both!

Climb the Second Layer of Shortcake Summit

The second layer of Shortcake Summit has four candles that you need to light by interacting with them. Follow the path listed below:

Walk up the sloping path towards the top of the cake. At the top of the slope is a candle with frosting in front of it. Remove the frosting with your Royal Shovel, then light the candle.

Just past the candle are two blueberries. Interact with the left blueberry to push it forward, then the right blueberry to push it into the alcove.

Behind the left blueberry is a Waffle Biscuit buried in the ground. Dig it up with your Royal Shovel, then pick it up.

Keep walking. You will reach a Waffle Biscuit blocking your path. Push it out of the way and walk past it.

However, the biscuit moves to block another candle, near the edge of the path. Interact with it a second time to push it back to its first location, then light the candle behind it.

The next candle is in front of you. It is completely surrounded by frosting, so dig up all the frosting and then light it.

There's a gap in front of you. Interact with the sparkling spot and place the Waffle Biscuit you picked up earlier down as a bridge.

Cross the gap. The final candle for this layer is on the other side, so light it !

Before heading up the sloped path to the next part of Shortcake Summit, walk along the small path to the left. At the end is a green chest containing the Horizontal Flamboyance merfolk fin cosmetic!

There are four candles you need to light while making your way to the very top of Shortcake Summit. You can do so by following this path:

Walk up the sloping path leading to the summit. At the top are two candles. Light both of them.

Continue walking left around the edge of the summit, keeping the giant cake topper on your right. You will see two more candles in front of you. They are not blocked by frosting or other obstacles, so go ahead and light them !

Solve the Art Supplies Sunken Echo Puzzles

As soon as you light the last candle, the pile of frosting atop Shortcake Summit disappears, revealing another Mermaid Statue and a Whirlpool.

Talk to Megara, who reveals that she is the Oracle - a nickname you, the Legendary Adventurer, gave her when you were a child. She says that, to protect Candy Cove from the villainous pirate, your next step is to claim the Keepsake beneath Shortcake Summit.

Turn into your merfolk form and dive into the whirlpool. There will be a set of Art Supplies floating in front of you. Interact with them, and the first Sunken Echo Puzzle will appear!

Read the note in front of the puzzle. The Legendary Adventurer and their friends are making up their own language, but they need pencils, paper, and paint for the project!

Solve the puzzle by completing the following steps:

Right in front of you are two purple arrows. The right arrow is pointing to a large, flat box. Interact with the box to push it onto the floor.

With the box gone, you can reach the yellow pad of paper on the bed. Pick it up.

The left purple arrow is also pointing to a large, flat box, this one on the left side of the puzzle. Interact with this box to push it onto the floor.

With this box gone, you can interact with the box at the very top of the pile, to the left of it. Interact with this box to slide it out of the way.

This reveals an open box with crayons inside. Pick up the crayons.

Swim over to the table where the Legendary Adventurer and their friends are sitting. To the left of the table, behind the group of two friends, is another box you can interact with. Push it to slide it out of the way.

Inside this box is a paint palette. Pick it up.

Interact with the table and place all three items on it.

This will solve the puzzle, and it will disappear!

Swim a little ways down the path in front of you until you see the second Sunken Echo Puzzle. Read the note . The Legendary Adventurer and their crew are passing notes in class, and you need to help them hide from the teacher!

Interact with the teacher, who is standing at the front of the room, to turn her around.

Pick up all the notes hidden around the classroom. The notes are found in the following locations: Attached to the blackboard, above the teacher's head On the bookshelf to the right of the teacher, about halfway up On the shelf to the left of the teacher, on the top shelf On the teacher's desk

Attached to the blackboard, above the teacher's head

On the bookshelf to the right of the teacher, about halfway up

On the shelf to the left of the teacher, on the top shelf

Interact with either of the student desks and place the four notes in the provided slots.

After both puzzles have been solved, the Bottled Art Supplies will appear in front of you. Pick it up to claim the Keepsake. The barrier disappears, and the area you were in is no longer cut off from the rest of the Dessert Depths!

Return to the surface via the Whirlpool!

Talk to Megara, who tells you that the river of melted icing is flowing again, so you can now explore deeper in Candy Cove. However, before you do that, she wants you to build her a House!

Using Furniture Mode, place Megara's House anywhere in Candy Cove. Then, interact with the Scrooge McDuck sign and spend 7,500 Star Coins to build the House!

Megara is now officially unlocked as a Villager. Take a photo with her to commemorate the occasion.

Talk to Megara to conclude the Quest. She tells you that Captain Hook has stolen the map leading to the other Keepsakes in Candy Cove, and says you will need to take the map back from him before you can find them.

articles.title: The Internet Reacts to Jensen Huang's Shock Return as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: The internet is reacting to Jensen Huang's shock return as Nvidia CEO.
articles.body:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following two weeks of scandals involving alleged affairs, with one involving a suspected spy.

Just last week, Nvidia CFO Collette Kress, who served as interim CEO during Huang's absence, had ruled out that he would return, and the company also took the opportunity to implement a new oversight committee to prevent more security scandals in the future.

While Nvidia was picking up the pieces, Huang went on his own journey to return to Nvidia , putting out a statement suggesting he would be willing to return as CEO if the board thought it would be best for the company. And, well, it seems like that's exactly what happened. In a press release issued earlier this morning, Nvidia Board Chair Harvey C. Jones said: "The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers."

It does seem like the U.S. Government played a big role in Huang's return. Nvidia's own statement says, "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk." President Donald Trump has also been posting through it, most recently saying that, "I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang. It would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A."

But in the hours since Huang's return, it's become clear just how much Trump tipped the scales in his favor. Trump spoke with Nvidia's board and brokered a deal to ensure his return, according to an interview with CNBC . Beyond saying that he "convinced them" and "made the deal," Trump gave Nvidia assurances over the national security implications. According to Trump: "And we gave them assurances at least with everything we know, and we know a lot."

Trump then called Huang personally, telling CNBC: "He knows what to do and what not to do. But I just said work hard because if you work hard, there’s nobody that can capture what you’ve done. Nobody, nobody close."

According to CBS senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang , "Trump says if Huang had not been reinstated at Nvidia, Xi might have called and asked him to lead a Chinese company. If Huang was 'mad' enough at the U.S. Trump said he may have done it… adding he has some of their 'blood in him.'"

Trump wasn't acting alone. According to Semafor White House correspondent Shelby Talcott, Vice President JD Vance played a big role in Huang's return too. Talcott tweeted: "VP JD Vance was deeply involved in the process to bring Jensen Huang back to Nvidia. He and POTUS were 'personally engaged' over the weekend to resolve the situation, a source familiar tells me — Vance used his relationships in Silicon Valley + business community to help move the Nvidia board along."

Nvidia bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO was always going to be a controversial move, but the Trump administration's role in the shocking development has caused backlash online.

Over on the Nvidia subreddit , most of the comments are calling out alleged corruption, with the top comment quoting Nvidia's input from the government, with the first reply saying, "lmaooo It's f**king hilarious to watch how corrupt that country is now." Another comment in the same thread simply says: "The USA is truly the most corrupt country among democracies."

In our own comments, user Killarogue added: "Society is broken. This dude should be investigated, and if the reports are true, sent to prison for illegally selling chips to customers in China. Specifically the H200 chips to blacklisted customers within China." While another user, ZeroZep, said: "Pretty disgusting but I guess that’s par for course in the society we live in today. Now let’s see the spy and shady business practice allegations magically go away too."

Meanwhile, on social media, the White House tweeted out Trump's thoughts on Huang's return : "The Nvidia Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO… Congratulations to Jensen, the Nvidia Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World!" There was also a critical mass of AI-generated gifs of Huang returning to the office.

At the same time, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker tweeted: "This is the greed and lack of accountability that the country just rejected. There are serious national security concerns being raised about Jensen Huang that should not be papered over by this administration or the Nvidia board."

Utah Senator John Curtis also had questions, posting on Twitter: "Nvidia’s board says it relied on input from senior U.S. officials to conclude that bringing Jensen Huang back posed no national security risk. I have some questions. Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board? And on what basis did the board conclude there was no risk?"

MSNBC's Sam Stein added: "I think it's worth being candid about what happened here. The U.S. government pressured the board of a private company to reinstate a CEO who had compromised U.S. national security and broken serious internal HR policies because they liked what he did to the share price."

But amid corruption concerns, there were plenty of people joking about the timing of Huang's return. Rapper Lotus Juice tweeted: "Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO? It’s almost like he took time off just for GTA6 lol"

Gamer's Nexus also joked about Huang's return, referencing Morrowind's classic "with this character's death, the thred of prophecy is severed," along with a caption that simply says: "Quick load."

Only time will tell if this saga is actually over, and what the long-term ramifications are going to be. During the course of Huang's absense, new allegations arose about his management style , and at one point Elon Musk even floated the idea of hiring him .

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Gives Us Our Closest Look at Doctor Doom's Mask Yet
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster that gives us our closest look at Doctor Doom's mask yet.
articles.body:
Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster that gives us our closest look at Doctor Doom's mask yet.

Robert Downey Jr.'s Victor von Doom debut is almost here. This new poster arrives hot on the heels of the movie's newest trailer , and while it focused on Steve Roger's (Chris Evans) role in the chaos, the poster gives one of the most iconic masks in comic book history the attention it deserves.

Considering all of the hubbub about Doctor Doom's different masks and costumes , it's nice to get a close-up of one of his most menacing looks and Downey Jr.'s dark green eye. You can see the full poster below.

Impressive details and rusty edges aside, many have also pointed out that there's more to this poster than meets the eye. No, there are no fun theories circulating about this one (yet), but it does continue to play into Downey Jr.'s ties to both Doctor Doom and his original Marvel Cinematic Universe hero, Iron Man.

One of the earliest MCU posters offered the same look at Iron Man's original Mark 3 design. Where Tony's poster gave audiences a new hero to take seriously, Doctor Doom's poster is more of a reminder of how far Marvel's heroes have come — and how far they still have to fall.

The reference is impossible to deny as fans continue to speculate how both of Downey Jr.'s characters may be connected. So far, Marvel has done its best to convince viewers that Doctor Doom is not a Tony Stark variant , but with posters like this only making the line between them darker, it's clear the MCU has more than a few fun surprises in store for next month.

articles.title: Family-Friendly Fortnite Streamer Goes Viral After Picking Up GTA 6 And Performing the Ultimate Heelturn, Including a Bloody Zoo Rampage
articles.summary: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit.
articles.body:
Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit.

For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite streams. His personal brand is based on pushing positivity, he's known for never swearing on camera, and he's become one of the few Twitch stars partnered with Epic Games to get a skin of himself made available in-game.

So it has, understandably, come as something of a surprise to see wholesome Nick Eh 30 embracing the most dastardly deeds GTA 6 has on offer: kicking pet dogs to death in the street , shooting animals in the zoo , and walking down the length of a train executing every passenger at point blank range .

As someone who has followed Nick Eh 30 for a while, seeing him wandering around GTA 6's world eliminating swathes of its animal population while chuckling to himself is indeed odd to see. Social media is awash with similar reactions, with posts from his followers stating things like: "IN WHAT UNIVERSE DO YOU NEED TO BE DOING THIS" and "Years of building ramps in Fortnite could not prepare chat for this."

But this is all clearly intentional, down to his streams being labelled as humorously promising "family friendly GTA" gameplay (I'm not sure there's any such thing). And the fact this has led people to actually discuss his streams and share clips further has only proven why he's likely doing this.

NickEh30 takes a taser to the Zoo in GTA VI — yoxic (@yoxics) November 22, 2026

NickEh30 takes a taser to the Zoo in GTA VI

All of that said, it's still a surprise to see Nick squarely aiming for the game's brutal "Irredeemable" criminal profile rating — a label that Rockstar has actually made quite difficult to achieve unless you really, really want to play the game as bloodily as possible.

It's this, seemingly, which has led to clips of Nick playing fetch with dogs using lumps of C4 , and throwing random NPCs from buildings .

articles.title: Naruto Movie Closes in on Casting Hiroyuki Sanada as Live-Action Hiruzen Sarutobi
articles.summary: Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie.
articles.body:
Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie .

The Mortal Kombat and Shogun actor's potential role in the anime-to-film adaptation was first reported by Deadline . Should talks with Cretton and Lionsgate check those last few boxes, he will appear as the Hidden Leaf Village's Hokage leader.

How Sanada may help the iconic Hokage lead to the big screen remains to be seen. Meanwhile, the site's report stated that Charles Melton (Warfare, Beef Season 2), who was said to be in final negotiations to play Kakashi back in August, is still in talks to join Naruto.

The Spider-Man: Brand New Day director's shot at bringing one of the most beloved manga and anime properties of all time into the live-action realm is expected to begin filming sometime in spring 2027 . With production right around the corner, though, Sony and Lionsgate have shared little about which actors have been picked to play some of the franchise's most important roles.

The only names we've heard so far are Melton and Sanada, and even their parts in the story haven't been outright confirmed just yet. Depending on what story Cretton and company hope to tell, there is still plenty of room for additional casting updates. Names like Sasuke, Sakura, and, of course, Naruto still have no names publicly attached, though that doesn't necessarily mean that stars haven't been picked behind the scenes.

Lionsgate confirmed it had initiated a global casting search for actors to play the leads in the live-action Naruto picture. Specifically, it said it was on the lookout for stars for Team 7, suggesting the actors picked to appear as Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura could be unknown names in the movie space.

"[Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto-sensei's] stories have inspired generations of fans around the world, and it’s an honor to bring his world and characters to the big screen in live action for the very first time," Cretton said at the time of the global casting search reveal. "I'm thrilled to kick off this worldwide casting search for our Team 7 and to bring the incredible universe of Naruto to life!"

The live-action Naruto movie currently has no release date. For more, you can check out Kishimoto's new manga tease . You can also catch up on how to watch all of Naruto in order .

articles.title: Yaga Gets Renewed for Season 2 at Crave, Carrie-Anne Moss to Return
articles.summary: Canadian streaming service Crave has greenlit the mystery thriller series Yaga for a second season, with Carrie-Anne Moss confirmed to return.
articles.body:
Canadian streaming service Crave has greenlit the mystery thriller series Yaga for a second season with Carrie-Anne Moss confirmed to return. The decision comes prior to Season 1's two-episode finale on November 27.

Yaga debuted on October 23 and quickly became #1 on Crave. It also took the top spot for its biggest "exclusive series launch ever" on AMC+ in the U.S., along with holding the #1 position in multiple other countries around the world.

“The incredible response to Yaga has blown us away,” Justin Stockman, vice president of global content for Bell Media said in a press release. “Congratulations to Kat Sandler and our production partners at Blink49 Studios and Front Street Pictures. Together, we’ve created a bold and daring Canadian series that we believe strongly in, and we can’t wait to see where Season 2 takes us.”

Pancho Mansfield, president of global scripted at Blink49 Studios, added, “Kat Sandler has brought such a bold and distinctive vision to Yaga, and we’re incredibly proud to have supported her in bringing it to the screen. To see her first television series as creator and showrunner resonate with audiences in Canada and around the world has been enormously rewarding. We’re thrilled to continue our partnership with Bell Media to bring the next chapter of Yaga to life.”

For those unfamiliar, Yaga is a modern retelling of the European folklore around Baba Yaga – a witch who takes on the role of both villain and mentor, harnessing both good and evil depending on the story. The new series is from Kat Sandler, who created a stage play of the same name and serves as writer, showrunner, and executive producer.

In our first two-episode review, we gave it an 8 saying, "Yaga evokes a kind of weirdness combined with a sultry, thriller mystery that sucks you right into the story. The show makes you feel like you’re a detective right alongside the main characters, trying to solve the case and pick up on all the strange and otherworldly clues along the way, while sitting on the edge of your seat waiting for the next episode to drop."

For more on Yaga, read what Sandler had to say about being inspired by Dexter and Hannibal, while also calling Baba Yaga the "OG bad girl of fairytales," in our exclusive interview from San Diego Comic-Con.

articles.title: Mandate Encampment Memory Flower Locations - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: In the Mandate Encampment, you'll find 19 Memory Flowers. This area is a bit more difficult than anything you've gone up against so far, so if
articles.body:
In the Mandate Encampment, you'll find 19 Memory Flowers. This area is a bit more difficult than anything you've gone up against so far, so if you're having trouble, don't be afraid to come back later when you're a bit more beefed up and able to take on these foes.

Found inside a small wooden house. You can get here by following the Sunset Path until you come to a large circular area, allowing you to go left, right, or forward. Go right into the desolate forest.

This flower is actually directly above the Cliffside Walkway Entrance Bell. So follow the path forward until you reach the section of wooden bridges connecting the canyon together. To your left, you'll find the next Memory Flower sitting on a small platform. Multiple Maskwalkers will appear before you reach it, so be prepared for a fight. After picking up the flower, be sure to kick the ladder back down to the bell.

As you continue through the wooden walkways, you'll find an elevator that will take you up to the upper levels of the walkways. There you'll find another Memory Flower. Be careful of the ranged enemies across the way; use a ranged Phantom Edge to deal with them before attempting to grab the flower.

Directly in front of the Mass Grave Bell, you'll find the third Memory Flower.

From the Mass Gave Bell, drop down the ledge until you're on the ground. Follow the river to the left, and you'll find enemies fighting a Sword Guardian. Help the Sword Guardian out, but then just like in Pangzhen, you'll need to kill the Sword Guardian before they turn. If you do it in time, a Memory Flower will be left in their place.

You'll only be able to actually claim the flower once you've completed the Tale: The Undying Heroic Spirit.

Head from the river to the Corpse-Eating Xue boss arena right across the way. Finish that fight and then head up the steep incline to the right of the arena. At the top will be your next flower.

Keep following the path west until you find the next Memory Flower on the wooden platform at the edge of a cliffside.

Found on the wooden archer platform right next to the Beneath The Watchtower Bell.

Keep following around the outside of the Battlefield Ruins. From picking up Memory Flower 8, continue following the outside wall until you go down the narrow path on the other end of the Battlefield Ruins. At the end of the dead end, you'll find the fifth Memory Flower.

From the Dovecote, go around the back of it; you'll find the flower on the floor behind it.

Go east of the Dovecote to find another Memory Flower inside a small series of caverns. You'll need to run along the outside wooden scaffolding to grab the flower that's on a high ledge inside the cave.

Inside the Main Encampment, you'll find another warrior that needs help. You've done this quite a few times at this point, but remember you'll need to kill the warrior before it turns. So we always recommend saving before attempting this. You'll still need to wait before you can grab this item, as you're coming up on the Chief Disciple boss, who will give you the required item to return to Myst's Tavern.

When you run into Red on top of the Dovecote, do not kill her there. Instead, leave and wait until you fight the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Star Formation. Red will reappear during this fight, and upon defeating both of them, you'll get twin memory flowers

One flower will be for Red, and the other will be for the Chief Disciple.

From the Path of the Baishan Falls Bell, continue forward until you run into another warrior that needs help. Rinse and repeat the same strategy. Clear out the enemies, kill the warrior before they turn, and wait to circle back and grab the Memory Flower once you've returned with the item needed.

South of Moji's House, all the way on the east side of the Mandate Encampment, you'll find, yes, you guessed it, another warrior who needs to be defeated before they turn. You're a pro at this by this point, so do whatever you've been doing and mark it so you can circle back and pick up the flower once you have the Shattered Hero's Courage.

The next set of Memory Flowers are found in the Training Grounds, and you'll be able to snag all of them after defeating Yubi the No. 21 Swordfighter Puppet. After defeating the boss, you'll be able to grab the first flower at the start of the wooden ramp.

The next flower can be found by taking the wooden scaffolding all the way around until you're high above near the entrance to the Training Grounds.

The final Memory Flower of the Mandate Encampment can be found at the top of the Training Grounds, in front of the gold chest in the center of the building inside.

That's everything you need for all of the Memory Flowers in the Mandate Encampment. For mroe tips, tricks, and guides, check out our full Phantom Blade 0 walkthrough.

articles.title: D'Angelo's Estate Speaks Out After Late Artist's Unreleased Song, Kamikaze, Discovered in GTA 6
articles.summary: The estate of late American R&B artist D’Angelo has spoken out after the launch of GTA 6, which featured a song that he created for the game back in 2024.
articles.body:
The estate of late American R&B artist D’Angelo has spoken out after the launch of GTA 6, which featured a song that he created for the game back in 2024.

GTA 6 features a slew of songs, both licensed and original, from a wide variety of high-profile music artists. Names like Cardi B, Tame Impala, Burna Boy, and many more contributed to the game’s soundtrack . D’Angelo was one of those artists who created a track for the game two years ahead of its highly anticipated November 2026 launch.

The song, titled ‘Kamikaze,’ is a funky tune that players quickly discovered during their playthroughs. Snippets of the track were uploaded to social media mere days after GTA 6’s release, and now, D’Angelo’s estate has officially confirmed the track’s existence in the game.

The track and its title were shared on November 23, 2026, in a series of Instagram posts on D’Angelo’s official profile. One of these included a statement penned by his brother, Luther Archer, who described how

“Michael approved this track in its current form in November of 2024 to be released as part of Grand Theft Auto VI. He was a tremendous admirer of Rockstar Games and a past collaborator of theirs, and he was enthusiastic (to say the least) to have this record included in the game and released to a wide audience as a single,” Archer wrote.

“Kamikazi was produced by D'Angelo himself, with Slingbaum and engineer/trusted ally Ben Kane. It features performances from D'Angelo and Slingbaum alongside Yussef Dayes (drums on the left) and the late legendary James Gadson (drums on the right). The cover artwork was done by Andre Trenier, the genius brother of Michael's mentor and longtime manager Dominque Trenier.”

D’Angelo has a storied history with Rockstar; he created a song for the Red Dead Redemption 2 soundtrack titled ‘May I? Stand Unshaken,’ a collaboration that came about after he asked to playtest the game at Rockstar’s New York Offices before its release.

“D’Angelo’s actually a massive, massive, massive fan of the game — more than I ever knew,” Rockstar Games’ Director of Music and Audio, Ivan Pavlovich, told Rolling Stone in a 2018 interview.

“He would come in here [Rockstar’s New York city office] and just play the game. We weren’t even talking about doing music. When D’Angelo comes through, he shows up at midnight, and he’s playing the game until four in the morning. Each time he was just like, ‘It’s incredible.’ It just blows his mind. He’s such a fan. I have never seen someone that excited.”

D’Angelo died of pancreatic cancer at the age of 51 in October 2025. Since then, his brother, Luther Archer, has taken over the task of releasing his posthumous works — one of which is featured in the biggest media release of all time from a company that was near and dear to D’Angelo’s heart.

articles.title: The Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Has Us Even More Confused About Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter
articles.summary: We've been confused about Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter ever since Avengers: Endgame, and the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday only raises further questions.
articles.body:
In case you’re currently trapped in a deep, dark, GTA-shaped hole, the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday has landed . This new trailer doesn’t necessarily reveal a lot about the plot of the film we didn’t already know, but it does give us a closer glimpse of two characters who are clearly going to be a big focus: Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers and Hayley Atwell’s Peggy Carter. In fact, it’s starting to look as though Steve is the main character of this massive ensemble movie.

That’s not necessarily a bad thing, especially for fans who have struggled to connect with the more recent superhero additions to the MCU. But it does highlight a problem the MCU has faced since Avengers: Endgame hit theaters back in 2019. Nothing about the strange new existence of Steve and Peggy makes much sense. Let’s try to break it down.

Avengers: Doomsday Poster Montage Gallery

We have so many questions surrounding the fates of Steve and Peggy after the Infinity Saga wrapped, and many of them have been burning since the final moments of Endgame. In case you’ve forgotten, Endgame wraps with Steve gathering the Infinity Stones and embarking on a quest to return them to their rightful points in time and space. We never see that quest play out (not even the surely awkward reunion between Steve and Red Skull on Vormir). Instead, we quickly realize that Steve never had any intention of returning from that final mission.

At that point, a much older and happier Steve shows up to pass the Captain America mantle to Anthony Mackie’s Sam Wilson. This version of Steve has clearly been living out a quiet life in the MCU for decades, enjoying the civilian life he was robbed of after becoming Cap. In the film’s final scene, it’s revealed that Steve’s final stop on his Infinity Stone quest was to reunite with Peggy in the 1950s, allowing them to finally share that long-awaited dance.

It’s a heartwarming ending, to be sure, but also one that raises a lot of weird questions. Did Steve really run off and retire in the past? How did no one ever notice Captain America hanging around in a time when he’s believed to be a dead war hero?

The questions only get more pressing the further you dig into this ending. As far as we’re aware, Peggy married a man in the 1950s and had children with him. Did Steve just erase all that from existence with his choice? Where was he at Peggy’s funeral in 2016’s Captain America: Civil War? And what about all the metahuman and alien-related incidents that have unfolded over the years? Did Steve just sit out those battles when he could have been helping?

However much the former Cap deserves some peace and contentment, it’s hard to understand how his choice to go back and be with Peggy doesn’t completely throw the MCU’s timeline out of whack. But the same could be said for the Avengers’ actions in Endgame as a whole. We still don’t fully understand the rules and mechanics of time travel in the MCU. Based on the many conflicting answers the Russo Bros. and others have given over the years, we’re not convinced they do, either. And now that we’ve plunged headlong into the Multiverse Saga, things are only becoming more confusing.

Avengers: Doomsday’s Steve Rogers Confusion

It seems as though Marvel is making at least some effort to address these lingering questions and the general uncertainty surrounding Steve and Peggy with the climax of the Multiverse Saga. The recently released Avengers Endgame: Encore ends with an extended version of that final Steve/Peggy scene . This time, their tender dance is interrupted by the arrival of Tom Hiddleston’s Loki. Specifically, this is the alternate 2012 version of Loki who partnered up with the Time Variance Authority.

That’s a good start. Thanks to his adventures with the TVA, Loki has a pretty firm grasp on what is and isn’t permissible when it comes to time travel and multiversal shenanigans. We’re not clear on whether this version of Loki is from after the series finale of the show ( when he took his place on the throne of the multiverse ), or if he’s coming from some point during the middle of the series. But either way, he’s clearly there to put the kibosh on Steve’s plan to f*** up the timeline.

Or is he? It sure doesn’t look as though Loki forces Steve to return to his rightful time and place. Instead, the final trailer seems to suggest that the two lovers move house and set up a new life elsewhere. We’re guessing that elsewhere is Earth-828, aka The Fantastic Four: First Steps universe. Presumably, the idea is that Steve can live quietly in a world that has no Captain America to begin with.

Whatever the case, Steve and Peggy maintain their new life long enough to raise a preteen son. Only at that point do the FF finally take notice of a family who by all rights should not exist in their world.

Loki’s intervention eases some of the immediate questions raised by Steve’s actions in Endgame, but it raises new ones in their place. Why is Loki so willing to help Steve and Peggy cheat the rules when the TVA is notoriously pretty rigid about upholding the natural order of things? Why does booting these two to a different universe not violate the organization’s mandate, especially after everything we saw in 2024’s Deadpool & Wolverine and all that Anchor Being business ? At what point does the elderly Steve return to his home universe?

But what really has us confused is the implication that Peggy now disappeared from the MCU in the 1950s. She’s supposed to be a very important figure post-WWII. She was instrumental in the founding of S.H.I.E.L.D. and worked with heroes like Michael Douglas’ Hank Pym. Is all of that just erased now, along with Peggy’s previous marriage? How does that not have a cascading ripple effect across the MCU? And how does the scene in Endgame where Steve travels back and sees Peggy at Camp LeHigh work now?

All we can think is that Peggy left behind some copy of herself to take her place on Earth-616. Maybe a Life Model Decoy? Or maybe Loki used his illusion magic to create a Peggy doppelganger. That would still require either option to be real enough to have sex and give birth, mind you.

Again, we really don’t understand how time travel works in the MCU, and we’re not sure the people writing these films and shows do, either. The entire situation with Steve and Peggy is one giant mass of confusion and awkward questions.

The most we can hope for is that Doomsday builds on the fact that these questions exist and that Steve’s very post-Endgame existence is so unnatural. Perhaps Steve’s selfish choice is why the multiverse is beginning to collapse. It certainly seems to be the onus behind Robert Downey, Jr.’s Doom’s warning to the Avengers, “All of you have lived stolen lives, and now you must give them back.” He may be a jerk, but we suspect Doom has a legitimate grievance with the former Captain America here.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Will Have to Testify Publicly Before US Senate
articles.summary: Earlier today, Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, after two weeks of scandals involving multiple affairs and a suspected spy. But while he's back in the pilot's seat, Huang's problems aren't over, and he's been summoned to testify in front of the US Senate.
articles.body:
Earlier today, Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO , after two weeks of scandals involving multiple affairs and a suspected spy. Although he's back in the pilot's seat, Huang's problems aren't over, as he's been summoned to testify in front of the U.S. Senate.

Jensen Huang has been summoned to testify in front of the Senate's Banking Committee on December 3, according to Bloomberg . The hearing was announced by the committee's chairman, Tim Scott, and will focus on oversight of U.S. export controls. That comes just a week after Nvidia announced that it would be establishing a National Security and Export Control Committee last week .

Huang's appearance in front of the Banking Committee is only the latest hearing that's been announced. Huang is also scheduled to appear in front of three House committees in two closed-doors meetings on December 1 and December 2 . While those congressional hearings will be closed to the public, they will be transcribed, and will likely also be covering Nvidia's adherance to U.S. export controls.

But while Huang will now have to testify in front of both houses of Congress, his reinstatement came after President Donald Trump intervened on his behalf . In Nvidia's own statement about the CEO's return, it said, "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk." It turns out that input came from President Trump, who called the board and gave "reassurances" that Huang's return wouldn't pose a national security risk.

While the President acted to have Huang reinstated, plenty of representatives from both parties have demanded answers on social media. Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren posted , saying, "This reckless decision to bring back Jensen Huang does not change the fact that Huang and NVIDIA still owe Congress answers. The Trump Administration needs to explain what 'input' was given and by which senior officials to support Huang’s reinstatement."

At the same time, Republican Senator John Curtis posted, "Nvidia’s board says it relied on input from senior U.S. officials to conclude that bringing Jensen Huang back posed no national security risk. I have some questions. Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board? And on what basis did the board conclude there was no risk?"

While this scandal built up steam in the background for months, it really exploded two weeks ago, when Huang admitted to an affair that kicked off an internal investigation into his conduct . He resigned just a few days later , and even though the board came out and said Huang wouldn't be reinstated , he reclaimed his office earlier today.

articles.title: The Rushed Rings of Power Episode Release Schedule Is Likely Thanks to Amazon's Black Friday Sale Strategy
articles.body:
Prime Video's The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 wraps up this Wednesday with its final two episodes. It's a surprisingly condensed release schedule for a billion-dollar TV series. Both Seasons 1 and 2 of the series were extended into more strung-out episode drops, so why is Amazon seemingly rushing this one?

Well, while we don't have confirmation from Amazon directly, the answer seems to be pretty obvious: Black Friday . The Rings of Power is Amazon's biggest series and is presumably a significant draw to get people to sign up for an Amazon Prime membership just in time for the biggest shopping holiday of the year.

2026 marks the first time new episodes of The Rings of Power started dropping in November, as both previous seasons kicked off near the beginning of September. If you consider this change in release timing in terms of Amazon's eCommerce business, the reason for this seems rooted in the service's free trial . New subscribers can get an Amazon Prime membership for free for 30 days, and both the premiere and the finale of the Prime Video LOTR show fit neatly in that window.

The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Photos

There's certainly nothing wrong with Amazon manipulating its Prime Video release schedule to aid the retail part of its business, assuming that is what is happening here. After all, the main draw of an Amazon Prime membership is that you get a streaming service and all of the Prime shopping benefits that come with it. The fact that Amazon is choosing to do this for the first time with Season 3 is what makes it so interesting.

Prime Video is one of the biggest streaming services out there right now, but it's been a part of their service since 2011. While you can actually get a Prime Video subscription without getting an Amazon Prime membership, the free trial is only available for the full shopping subscription. So it's these big original shows like Rings of Power and Fallout that most likely drive high rates of free trial sign-ups to the service every year. For the folks who are only grabbing the free trial to watch the show and then cancelling after binge-watching, however, there's only a small window of time in which Amazon has to convince them to continue on with their subscription.

With the streaming services becoming more and more expensive every year, this shift in Amazon's release schedule feels like a big deal. I myself have cancelled and renewed several streaming subscriptions this year based on the new shows coming out. I have very little time to watch TV in my week, so it's become harder for me to justify paying a monthly fee for something I'm not actively using. Amazon appears to be making an effort to adjust to this sort of mentality by aligning the rest of its subscription benefits with its biggest TV release of the year. We won't see how well this strategy works out for them this year until Amazon reveals its Q4 revenue numbers, but I have a feeling this is only the beginning of a much larger shift in streaming service strategy moving forward.

articles.title: GTA 6 Players Are Upset Its New Train Can Actually Be Stopped After Spending 13 Years With the Unstoppable GTA 5 Train
articles.summary: GTA 5's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop GTA 6's train – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.
articles.body:
GTA 5 's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop the one in GTA 6 – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.

What better way to spend the early days of a project that Rockstar Games fans waited 13 years for than to immediately do the same thing they've already been doing? As players were dropped into the south end of Leonida, many immediately took Jason as far as they could just to find a train to stand in front of.

There is, indeed, a new train screeching over the tracks surrounding Vice City, but there's a problem – it has no aura.

Finally, the train in GTA 6 has come to stop 😭😭😭😭

So sánh tàu hỏa đối đầu với các phương tiện trong GTA5 vs GTA6 vs PDR2 — Troy Ah Keith (@TroyAhKeith) November 23, 2026

So sánh tàu hỏa đối đầu với các phương tiện trong GTA5 vs GTA6 vs PDR2

If you're one of the few people who hasn't picked up GTA 5 since it launched in 2013, you still may have heard about its unstoppable train. The iconic black, yellow, and white locomotive patrols Los Santos and has for years, and unlike just about every other vehicle in the game, there's nothing Michael, Franklin, or Trevor can do to stop it.

Dumb trucks, C4, planes, rows of cars – you name it. No one has ever been able to get GTA 5's train to budge. After 13 years of trying, it's become a meme on the internet to try and move the train, resulting in countless videos that have cropped up from those seeking to test its mettle (and farm a bit of engagement on social media).

Naturally, GTA 6 presented an updated take on the opportunity when players discovered its train. Unfortunately, Rockstar's commitment to realism means moving the new locomotive isn't just possible; it's actually kind of easy. Crash into it with a dump truck? Works like a charm. Park an excavator in its path? Stops it in its tracks. Raise a bridge? Completely detailed. Rockstar's new, smarter NPCs even have the brains to pull the brakes when they see a person simply standing in their way.

This is where we get into the argument that has plagued Rockstar both inside and outside of the studio for years: When is a game too realistic? Judging by GTA 6's record-breaking earnings and all-time great reviews , it seems the developers' new playground struck a nice balance between being grounded and goofy. Of course, that hasn't stopped a small section of players from being upset that Leonida plays by many of the same rules that we do in the real world.

After GTA 5's train spent more than a decade as the running champ of viral videos to come out of Los Santos, players aren't ready to let GTA 5's train go. In fact, some have began to almost deify the 2013 locomotive, creating fan edits showing the last train as the superior vehicle in the locomotive power-scaling battle.

"Yeah, this and the 'No first-person mode' are the biggest downsides for me," one X/Twitter user said .

articles.title: GTA 6 Praised for Its Accurate Portrayal of Felon Rehabilitation
articles.summary: GTA 6 is receiving praise for its commentary on how hard it is for felons to start a life and the system that breeds crime.
articles.body:
GTA 6 is receiving praise for its commentary on how hard it is for felons to start a new life and the system that breeds crime.

In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia choose a life of crime in hopes of creating financial stability in their lives. Their goal isn't necessarily to get rich and buy flashy cars or a mansion, but so they can lay the foundation for their family. Although Jason runs drugs for a local crime boss, Lucia in particular is the one who really pushes them to take on more ambitious jobs. Some players felt that her decision-making at the start of the game was a bit reckless, given that she just got out of prison — but if you read her text messages, things begin to make a lot more sense.

Players realized that her parole officer had denied her petition to take a job at a local bar, one of her only options for employment because she knew someone who worked there that could vouch for her. Without that, her record as a convicted felon would make it difficult for employers to consider her for a position. Her PO also noted that she's overdue on paying court-ordered parole fees, which she can't pay because she doesn't have a job, putting her in a vicious cycle.

Lucia's willingness to get back into crime makes a lot more sense when you look at her texts with her PO and see that they denied her request to get a job but still wanted her to pay bills she has no money for — Nikuo 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 (@MEATMAAAAN) November 23, 2026

Lucia's willingness to get back into crime makes a lot more sense when you look at her texts with her PO and see that they denied her request to get a job but still wanted her to pay bills she has no money for

This pushes Lucia to get involved with shady characters who turn her life with Jason upside down. A number of fans have praised this particular narrative beat, including some who have worked within this very system.

"As someone who worked as part of the system years ago, not as a PO but a case manager, this is wildly accurate to real life," said X user Mgs2master . "Rockstar did their homework here."

"GTA 6 is brave enough to try and educate the player on how desperation can drive you to crime through how it incorporates gameplay mechanics into the story," said one player . "It's genuinely one of the best uses of ludonarrative I’ve ever seen, period. I am floored."

"As someone who's had family that has had to go through this s**t, it's genuinely not satirical," said another user . "This is straight up just what happens. The system is designed to funnel criminals back into crime by denying them opportunities needed to rehabilitate themselves to keep prisons full."

Another person noted that this system blocks people out of having a reasonable chance of developing a good life: "The US has a recidivism problem because once you have a felony you're essentially locked out of a good chunk of employment and housing stuff, and then these orgs act surprised when people go back to crime. The econ equivalent of kicking people while they're down."

Rockstar Games writer Rupert Humphries told Love Magazine earlier this year that the "American Dream" as we know it has scaled down for many people with each passing GTA game. Now, people just want a foundation to live and build a family, but the state of the world has made that increasingly unattainable, and in the case of GTA 6, it leads to the characters taking matters into their own hands.

"Some would say the American Dream collapsed a long time ago," said Humphries. "With GTA 4, we told an immigrant’s story that was supposed to be a kind of hollow commentary on the illusion of America as a land of opportunity, and then we sort of doubled down on that with the cynicism of GTA 5. Maybe the American Dream is more modest now. It’s a house for your family and your loans paid off instead of wild success — but maybe today, that is just as out of reach for the average person. Miami and Southern Florida are a particular front line for this battle between astronomical wealth and unbounded ambition, creating a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity."

Of course, GTA 6 is still fiction and isn't an endorsement of real crime, despite how much some people would like you to believe otherwise . It's more so putting two charcaters in these circumstances and seeing how they react to the cards they're dealt. There also wouldn't be much of a game if Lucia decided to just spend the rest of her days scrounging for minimum wage work, after all.

GTA 6 has been a roaring success so far, generating over $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours with over 32.5 million copies sold in pre-sales alone. The game is also a critical smash hit, tying with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the best reviewed video game in history on Metacritic. IGN gave GTA 6 a 10 out of 10 , praising it for its depth and detail.

"Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, GTA 6 has not stopped astonishing me since I started it," reads an excerpt from the review. "I regularly find myself in love with video games, but it’s extraordinarily rare that I find myself in complete awe of them. Put simply, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."

The graphics in GTA 6 are so realistic that actual photos and videos are being mistaken as screenshots or clips from the game.

It feels like every social media platform is chock-full of posts about Rockstar’s latest release, which has cemented itself as the biggest entertainment launch of all time . Everybody’s talking about it; it’s practically impossible to scroll through your timeline without seeing it in some form or another.

GTA 6 is a good-looking game, to say the least, with some of the most realistic visuals we’ve seen in a digital world thus far — to the point where it’s genuinely hard to tell the difference between what’s from the game and what’s from real life.

For instance, a video taken from influencer India Love’s live stream sparked a swath of comments from viewers who had to do a double-take to make sure they weren’t watching a clip from GTA 6, partly owing to the lighting. If anything, that just goes to show how realistic the game’s lighting really is, with one user writing on Twitter/X, “Why is everything lit so well in that game? How did they do that?”

articles.title: Call of Duty's Player Count Dropped by Over 40% Following GTA 6's Release, According to Analysts
articles.summary: A new report claims that Call of Duty saw an over 40% drop in players following GTA 6's release.
articles.body:
A new report claims that Call of Duty saw an over 40% drop in players following GTA 6's release.

We've known all year long that Rockstar Games was going to dominate the final two months of 2026 thanks to the release of GTA 6. It's why a lot of publishers moved their games either into 2027 or pushed them up to September to steer clear of the blast radius. Call of Duty, however, releases on an annual cycle around October or November, which means Modern Warfare 4's post-launch plans were beginning right around the time of GTA 6's launch.

According to Alinea Analytics, it appears that Call of Duty lost almost half of its player base during GTA 6's record-breaking launch weekend . The Call of Duty app (which consists of Warzone, Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4) saw a 42% drop across platforms, taking the overall daily player count from 7.6 million users to 4.4 million users. There's likely a lot of crossover between GTA and Call of Duty's audiences, so it's no surprise to see a drop in players, but nearly half clearly highlights just how much of an event GTA 6 is.

Call of Duty app (MW4, Warzone, and BO7) lost 42% of players following GTA 6's launch, down from 7.6M daily active users to 4.4M PS5 saw the biggest drop off out of all platforms with 44% decline in players, per Alinea Analytics — CharlieIntel (@charlieINTEL) November 23, 2026

Call of Duty app (MW4, Warzone, and BO7) lost 42% of players following GTA 6's launch, down from 7.6M daily active users to 4.4M PS5 saw the biggest drop off out of all platforms with 44% decline in players, per Alinea Analytics

Earlier this fall, Activision chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl stated that he believed GTA 6 would actually help Call of Duty , as the open-world crime epic would drive more attention toward gaming as a whole. People are buying new consoles or dusting off old ones to play this game, so in theory, they will turn their attention toward other titles once they are done with GTA. Whether that title is Call of Duty remains to be seen, but currently, it appears to only be hurting the series in the immediate short term. Things will probably bounce back up, but it'll be interesting to see how many people return.

This also may not be the last time Call of Duty takes a hit from GTA 6. There are expected to be at least two more big beats or launches for this game, with the PC release rumored for an early 2027 release . However, the even bigger moment will come in the form in the inevitable online mode. Rockstar hasn't talked about its plans for GTA 6's online offerings yet, but it's highly speculated to release sometime next year . If it drops in the summer, it may not hurt Call of Duty a ton since that is the period where the most hardcore fans are still grinding away on the game.

But if GTA 6 Online dropped next fall, around October or November, it could put Call of Duty in a really difficult position. It'll be an interesting story to follow, but Call of Duty has been battling intense competition for two straight years now thanks to Battlefield 6 in 2025 and GTA 6 this year. Maybe it can contend next year, but the jury is still out.

articles.title: GTA 6 Was Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
articles.summary: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.
articles.body:
Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.

PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles.

On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days.

What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles.

GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours.

On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever , with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November.

People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.”

It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. Rockstar certainly set a new standard for the industry with this one, to the point where many users aren’t sure if a photo they see online is from the real world or from the game .

articles.title: Save Up to $1,100 Off the 2026 65" Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED Ultimate Gaming TVs for Black Friday
articles.summary: RGB Mini-LED tech boasts richer colors, a brighter picture, and wider viewing angles than ever before.
articles.body:
Last year, Hisense pioneered the first RGB Mini-LED TV with its 116UX model. Granted it was only available as a massive 116" screen that retailed for $20,000. In 2026, Hisense released its second generation RGB Mini-LED tech at a much more affordable price point with its UR-series lineup. For Black Friday, you can get it for even less. Best Buy has just discounted the 65" Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED TV from $2,000 all the way down to $899.99 and the 75" model from $2,500 down to $1399.99, both with free delivery. These are the lowest prices since launch and beats previous lows by $200.

The Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED TV Gives OLED a Run for Its Money

RGB Mini-LED is essentially the next generation evolution of Mini-LED technology. Traditional mini-LED TVs consist of an array of blue LED that are passed through RGB filters to produced the desired color. RGB Mini-LED TVs use red, green, and blue LEDs instead of just blue, which means the pixels no longer need filters to produce the desired color. The result is more accurate color reproduction, less blooming and, most importantly, a wider color gamut. In fact, the color gamut of RGB Mini-LED surpasses that of OLEDs, since current-generation OLEDs also use color filters combined with blue OLEDs. How does that translate in the real world? It means that you see richer, more accurate colors, smoother gradients and less banding than even OLEDs, especially in 4K HDR content.

RGB Mini-LED TVs have several other features that out-class standard Mini-LEDs. They're brighter (far brighter than OLED TVs), making them perfect for daytime watching in bright rooms with little light control. They offer much better viewing angles, which means everyone you're hosting will enjoy the game wherever they're positioned around the TV. Gamers will benefit from this TV as well. The Hisense UR8 boasts a 180Hz native refresh rate, the highest I've ever seen for a TV, with HDMI 2.1 inputs that will pair seamlessly with a PlayStation 5 console for seamlessly running games in 4K.
